## What is PU learning?

Positive and Unlabeled (PU) learning addresses settings where only positives are labeled,
and the remaining data are unlabeled (not guaranteed negatives).

## When to use xplus

Use `xplus` when you have confirmed positives, high class imbalance, and sparse high-dimensional features.

## Basic workflow

```{r eval=FALSE}
library(xplus)
set.seed(1)
x <- matrix(rnorm(200 * 10), ncol = 10)
y <- c(rep(1, 40), rep(0, 160))

fit <- xplus(x, y)
summary(fit)
predict(fit, newx = x, type = "response")
assess(fit, newx = x, newy = y)
```
